review:
Both Cash Kings in one game. Donny symbols build LootLines – three or more on a winning line each pick a value from the Cash Board, and the line pays their total. Danny symbols expand into Dollar-Reels after regular wins.

Every spot on a Dollar-Reel shows a multiplier and can join a LootLine, so the two characters make each other stronger. Booster symbols push values higher in the Make It Reign and Cash Kings Forever bonuses. 12,500x max.
